ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a chemical transformation flow. The left end is "pale green crystal"; after adding "dilute H2SO4", a "solution" labeled (A) is obtained; after adding "K2Cr2O7" again, it becomes a "green solution"; after continuing to add "NaOH (excess)", the right side separates into a "bright green solution" labeled (B) and a "red-brown precipitate" labeled (C). From (C), adding "HCl" and "KNCS/KSCN" downward gives a "blood-red solution" labeled (D); then adding "NaF" to (D) gives a "colorless solution" labeled (E). Reasoning: Analyze according to the order of the arrows in the figure. The pale green crystal forms solution (A) with dilute sulfuric acid, and pale green usually indicates that it contains Fe2+. After adding K2Cr2O7, Fe2+ is oxidized to Fe3+. After adding excess NaOH again, a red-brown precipitate (C) appears; the red-brown hydroxide precipitate can be determined to be Fe(OH)3, so (C) contains an Fe(III) precipitate. Subsequently, (C) dissolves in HCl to provide Fe3+, and then reacts with KSCN to generate the blood-red solution (D), indicating that Fe3+—SCN complex exists in (D). Finally, adding NaF to the blood-red solution (D), F- forms a more stable and colorless fluoroiron(III) complex ion with Fe3+, causing the blood-red color to disappear, so (E) should be the hexafluoroferrate(III) ion [FeF6]3-.

method.method_draft: 按图中箭头顺序推理：由淡绿色晶体和稀硫酸可判断 A 含 Fe2+；加入 K2Cr2O7 后 Fe2+ 被氧化为 Fe3+。过量 NaOH 后出现红棕色沉淀 C，确认为 Fe(OH)3。C 溶于 HCl 后提供 Fe3+，加 KSCN 生成血红色 D，说明 D 中有 Fe3+—SCN 配合物。最后向 D 中加 NaF，F- 夺取 Fe3+ 并形成稳定无色配离子，因此 E 为 [FeF6]^{3-}。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一条化学转化流程。左端为“淡绿色晶体”，加入“稀H2SO4”后得到标为(A)的“溶液”；再加入“K2Cr2O7”后变为“绿色溶液”；继续加入“NaOH（过量）”后，右侧分出标为(B)的“亮绿色溶液”和标为(C)的“红棕色沉淀”。由(C)向下加入“HCl”和“KNCS/KSCN”后得到标为(D)的“血红色溶液”；再向(D)中加入“NaF”，得到标为(E)的“无色溶液”。
推理：按图中箭头顺序分析，淡绿色晶体与稀硫酸形成(A)溶液，淡绿色通常指示其中含有Fe2+。加入K2Cr2O7后，Fe2+被氧化为Fe3+。再加入过量NaOH后出现红棕色沉淀(C)，红棕色氢氧化物沉淀可确定为Fe(OH)3，因此(C)中含Fe(III)沉淀。随后(C)溶于HCl提供Fe3+，再与KSCN反应生成血红色溶液(D)，说明(D)中存在Fe3+—SCN配合物。最后向血红色溶液(D)中加入NaF，F-与Fe3+形成更稳定且无色的氟合铁(III)配离子，使血红色消失，因此(E)应为六氟合铁(III)酸根离子[FeF6]3-。

raw_record.original_question:
根据下图所示的实验现象,确定各字母 E 所代表的物质。

$\\boxed{\\text{实验现象:}}$
$\\begin{array}{c}
\\textbf{实验 1:} & \\text{将 E 置于试管中,E 不溶于水。}\\\\
\\textbf{实验 2:} & \\text{将 E 置于酒精中,E 溶解。}\\\\
\\textbf{实验 3:} & \\text{将 E 置于盐酸中,E 不溶解且没有气体产生。}\\\\
\\textbf{实验 4:} & \\text{将 E 置于氢氧化钠溶液中,E 不溶解且没有气体产生。}
\\end{array}$
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure there is a chemical transformation flow. The left end is "pale green crystal"; after adding "dilute H2SO4", a "solution" labeled (A) is obtained; after adding "K2Cr2O7" again, it becomes a "green solution"; after continuing to add "NaOH (excess)", the right side separates into a "bright green solution" labeled (B) and a "red-brown precipitate" labeled (C). From (C), adding "HCl" and "KNCS/KSCN" downward gives a "blood-red solution" labeled (D); then adding "NaF" to (D) gives a "colorless solution" labeled (E).
Reasoning: Analyze according to the order of the arrows in the figure. The pale green crystal forms solution (A) with dilute sulfuric acid, and pale green usually indicates that it contains Fe2+. After adding K2Cr2O7, Fe2+ is oxidized to Fe3+. After adding excess NaOH again, a red-brown precipitate (C) appears; the red-brown hydroxide precipitate can be determined to be Fe(OH)3, so (C) contains an Fe(III) precipitate. Subsequently, (C) dissolves in HCl to provide Fe3+, and then reacts with KSCN to generate the blood-red solution (D), indicating that Fe3+—SCN complex exists in (D). Finally, adding NaF to the blood-red solution (D), F- forms a more stable and colorless fluoroiron(III) complex ion with Fe3+, causing the blood-red color to disappear, so (E) should be the hexafluoroferrate(III) ion [FeF6]3-.
